## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] `./gradlew check` passes; no test weakened or skipped.
- [ ] Ported code carries the EUPL + "Ported from TerraFirmaCraft ... @ commit" header; `docs/porting/ledger.md` updated, every divergence has a row.
- [ ] Threading: decide async, apply sync. No world access off the owning region; no BukkitScheduler; `core/` and `worldgen/` have no platform imports.
- [ ] Performance: no new per-tick or per-block work. A hot path has a JMH benchmark or a budget row in `docs/perf/budgets.md`.
      If a budget regresses by more than 20 %, add a line `perf-note: <reason>` below.
- [ ] Generated content is regenerated by datagen, not edited by hand.
